{"version": "Notebook/1.0", "items": [{"type": 1, "content": {"json": "# ⚙️ Delivery Optimization — Efficienza
---
Quanto è efficace il peer-caching? Quanta banda WAN viene risparmiata, quali device contribuiscono come seeder, quali hanno cache fredda."}, "name": "title"}, {"type": 9, "content": {"version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "parameters": [{"id": "timeRange", "version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "name": "TimeRange", "type": 4, "isRequired": true, "value": {"durationMs": 604800000}, "typeSettings": {"selectableValues": [{"durationMs": 3600000}, {"durationMs": 86400000}, {"durationMs": 604800000}, {"durationMs": 2592000000}]}}]}, "name": "parameters"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize Peer=sum(BytesFromPeers), HTTP=sum(BytesFromHttp), Cache=sum(BytesFromCacheServer)
         by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend Total=Peer+HTTP+Cache
| extend PeerPct=round(100.0*Peer/iif(Total==0,1,Total), 1),
         CachePct=round(100.0*Cache/iif(Total==0,1,Total), 1),
         HttpPct=round(100.0*HTTP/iif(Total==0,1,Total), 1)
| project TimeGenerated, PeerPct, CachePct, HttpPct
| order by TimeGenerated asc", "size": 0, "title": "📈 Efficienza peer/cache nel tempo (%)", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "linechart", "chartSettings": {"yAxis": ["PeerPct", "CachePct", "HttpPct"]}}, "name": "effTrend"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize Peer=sum(BytesFromPeers), HTTP=sum(BytesFromHttp), Cache=sum(BytesFromCacheServer), Total=sum(TotalBytesDownloaded)
| extend
    SavedWAN_GB=round((Peer+Cache)/1073741824.0, 2),
    SavedWAN_Pct=round(100.0*(Peer+Cache)/iif(Total==0,1,Total), 1),
    PeerOnly_Pct=round(100.0*Peer/iif(Total==0,1,Total), 1),
    Cache_Pct=round(100.0*Cache/iif(Total==0,1,Total), 1)", "size": 4, "title": "💰 Banda risparmiata", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "tiles", "tileSettings": {"titleContent": {"columnMatch": "SavedWAN_Pct", "formatter": 12}, "leftContent": {"columnMatch": "SavedWAN_GB", "formatter": 12}, "showBorder": true}}, "name": "savedKpi"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| where TotalBytesDownloaded > 0
| extend Bucket=case(
    PercentPeerCaching == 0, '0% (nessun peer)',
    PercentPeerCaching <= 25, '1-25%',
    PercentPeerCaching <= 50, '26-50%',
    PercentPeerCaching <= 75, '51-75%',
    PercentPeerCaching < 100, '76-99%',
    '100% (full peer)')
| summarize Jobs=count() by Bucket
| order by Bucket asc", "size": 0, "title": "📊 Distribuzione PercentPeerCaching (job)", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "barchart"}, "name": "peerHistogram"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize HttpBytes=sum(BytesFromHttp),
            PeerBytes=sum(BytesFromPeers),
            Total=sum(TotalBytesDownloaded), Jobs=count()
         by DeviceName, Domain
| where Total > 0
| extend HttpPct=round(100.0*HttpBytes/Total, 1),
         HttpMB=round(HttpBytes/1048576.0, 1),
         TotalMB=round(Total/1048576.0, 1)
| project DeviceName, Domain, Jobs, TotalMB, HttpMB, HttpPct
| order by HttpMB desc
| take 25", "size": 0, "title": "⬇️ Top 25 device per traffico HTTP/CDN", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "table", "gridSettings": {"formatters": [{"columnMatch": "HttpMB", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "red"}}]}}, "name": "topHttpDevices"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize HttpBytes=sum(BytesFromHttp),
            PeerBytes=sum(BytesFromPeers),
            CacheBytes=sum(BytesFromCacheServer),
            Total=sum(TotalBytesDownloaded),
            Jobs=count() by DeviceName, Domain
| where Total > 104857600  // > 100 MB
| extend PeerPct=round(100.0*PeerBytes/iif(Total==0,1,Total), 1),
         HttpMB=round(HttpBytes/1048576.0, 1),
         TotalMB=round(Total/1048576.0, 1)
| where PeerPct < 5
| project DeviceName, Domain, Jobs, TotalMB, HttpMB, PeerPct
| order by HttpMB desc
| take 50", "size": 0, "title": "🥶 Device con cache 'fredda' (>100MB, <5% peer)", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "table"}, "name": "coldDevices"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

            Total=sum(TotalBytesDownloaded), Devices=dcount(DeviceName) by Domain
| extend PeerPct=round(100.0*Peer/iif(Total==0,1,Total), 1),
